message.content: Li Hua did indeed ask Jennifer Moore for book recommendations on fitness nutrition earlier. According to the conversation recorded in source 1, Li Hua expressed interest in deepening her understanding of fitness nutrition and sought recommendations from Jennifer. Jennifer responded by suggesting "The New Rules of Lifting" by Lou Schuler and Alwyn Cosgrove, as well as "Precision Nutrition," which includes online courses that Li Hua might be interested in. Therefore, there was a clear prior interaction regarding fitness nutrition resources before the announcement about the special guest speaker at the gym.
